title: chaetogastra stenophylla
intro: Chaetogastra stenophylla, commonly known as the African or tropical milk thistle, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating liver and gallbladder issues, and it is also used to enhance lactation in breastfeeding mothers. The therapeutic actions of Chaetogastra stenophylla include hepatoprotective, galactagogue, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include silymarin, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
